add_definitions(-D_WINE)
include_directories(BEFORE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)
spec2def(winmm.dll winmm.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_subdirectory(midimap)

# winmm.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winmm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(winmm_shims OBJECT driver.c joystick.c lolvldrv.c mci.c mmio.c playsound.c registry.c time.c winmm.c)
target_link_libraries(winmm_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libuserenv libadvapi32 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(winmm_shims PRIVATE -Wno-unused-but-set-variable)
endif()
add_cargo_module(winmm winmm-cargo winmm.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS winmm_shims psdk)
